summary: Phase 149O.10.2 -- HSCE-001 Atomic No-Clobber Repair Independent Re-Verification: independent contract re-verification-only phase (no HSCE-001/HATP-001/RAE-001 amendment, no production implementation, no CLI implementation, no hardware provisioning, no signing execution, no Permission Broker change, no rollback dispatch behavior change). Ran the full required initial inspection (git status/log, pcae health/check/status coherence/doctor task-memory/push check/runtime inspect, telegram notify status, phase-report show --latest and reconcile --phase-id 149O.10.1) and confirmed the expected baseline: 149O.10.1 completed/complete/pushed/consistent, HSCE-001 v1.1 REPAIRED AT CONTRACT LEVEL PENDING INDEPENDENT RE-VERIFICATION, HATP production NOT READY, runtime Observed/observe/unavailable. Read HSCE-001 v1.1's full canonical contract text directly (not trusting 149O.10.1's own report), the 149O.9/149O.10/149O.10.1 phase docs, and rollback_approval_evidence.py's _write_atomic_json and write_creation_registration (O_CREAT|O_EXCL) production precedent. Independently reconstructed the v1.0-to-v1.1 diff via git diff against the 149O.9 freeze commit (3ad4e839) and the 149O.10.1 repair commit (0cc32d09): exactly 5 hunks, all classifiable as VERSION_BUMP / REQ_052_EXCLUSIVE_PUBLICATION / ATTACK_MATRIX_AG3_ADDITION / REQ_COUNT_CORRECTION / REPAIR_HISTORY, zero UNRELATED. Independently re-derived the requirement inventory (79, HSCE-REQ-001..079, sequential, gapless, no duplicates) and attack-matrix count (21 items, item 21 confirmed as the AG3 original_commit_sha-resolution analogue) directly from the contract text via regex extraction, not by trusting either phase's own summary. Independently reconstructed HSCE-REQ-052 as an abstract state machine (ABSENT / CANONICAL(bytes)) distinct from 149O.10.1's own model, and exhaustively/randomly proved the single-canonical-winner invariant: all 2-writer permutations (identical and differing payloads), all unique 3-writer orderings (AAA/AAB/ABC), and 200 randomized 2-to-12-writer trials -- zero invariant violations in any trial. Independently ran real-filesystem os.link probes on this platform (Darwin/macOS/APFS): single-writer absent-destination success; existing-destination second-link FileExistsError with destination bytes unchanged; concurrent 2/8/32-writer identical races (exactly one winner, n-1 losers, final bytes intact); concurrent 2/8/32-writer differing races (exactly one winner, final bytes equal winner's candidate, every loser's candidate independently confirmed distinct from the final); a mixed 4-identical+4-differing 8-writer race; symlink-at-destination detection via os.path.islink() before any compare; orphan-temp-file non-authoritativeness for both winner and loser cleanup paths -- all probes run 5 consecutive times with identical results (os.link exclusivity is OS-guaranteed, not timing-dependent, so zero flakiness observed). EXDEV/unsupported-hard-link-filesystem could not be forced without a second real filesystem mount in this environment and is explicitly disclosed as DEFERRED, reasoned from contract text only (no fallback to os.replace for any non-FileExistsError OSError, independently reconfirmed present in the text). Independently reconfirmed symlink/path preservation (HSCE-REQ-057/058 byte-unchanged, explicitly cross-referenced by the repaired requirement's loser branch), canonical byte-comparison semantics (HSCE-REQ-053 byte-unchanged, used identically for both the winner's write and the loser's compare), crash-before/during/after-publish semantics (reasoned from the text's own step ordering: fsync strictly precedes the os.link attempt; a crash after successful link leaves the final artifact intact regardless of cleanup completion), and non-regression of every section 149O.10.1 did not touch (SC-1 through SC-12 all present, only SC-7's mechanism repaired; CLI grammar, locators, envelope schema, evidence-ID formula, error vocabulary, evidence-store layout all confirmed byte-unchanged by the diff scan). Independently reconfirmed F-1 (count correction, no unmarked current-state claim of 78 survives outside explicit historical quotations), F-2 (_write_atomic_json reuse wording, reconfirmed the cited production function still has no symlink check, matching the repaired wording's own framing), and Obs-2 (AG3 attack-matrix item 21 present and correctly worded) all CLOSED. Recorded two new non-blocking findings: Obs-3 -- the loser-comparison-read-failure case (e.g. destination occupied by a directory, independently reproduced this phase to raise FileExistsError on os.link, which would then raise IsADirectoryError on a subsequent read) has no explicit error_type mapping in the contract text; recommended folding a narrow evidence_persistence_failure clarification into the future implementation-plan phase rather than a dedicated repair phase, since the fail-closed default is already the contract's general pattern for unspecified OSError cases. Obs-4 -- 149O.10.1's own canonical phase report (and PROJECT_STATUS.md's prior Current Phase entry) claimed 89 passed for tests/test_phase_149o_10_hatp_signing_ceremony_evidence_store_contract_independent_verification.py; independently re-run twice this phase (standalone and inside the targeted regression sweep), the actual, reproducible count is 29 passed (29 tests collected) -- a report-trust documentation defect in 149O.10.1's own report, not a contract or code defect; flagged per this phase's own governing instruction not to trust the prior report over the contract/tests themselves. New dedicated suite tests/test_phase_149o_10_2_hsce_001_atomic_no_clobber_reverification.py: 66 passed, run 5 consecutive times with identical results -- written independently of the 149O.10.1 suite (no shared constants/helpers), covering requirement inventory, diff reconstruction, HSCE-REQ-052 state-machine text extraction, error mapping, symlink non-regression, canonical comparison, finding dispositions, untouched-section non-regression, the abstract permutation/randomized model, the real os.link probes described above, and production/contract boundary checks. 149O.9 suite (60 passed) and 149O.10.1 suite (43 passed, matching its own claimed count exactly) both reconfirmed unaffected; 149O.10 suite independently reconfirmed at 29 passed (see Obs-4). Fast Green: 4590 passed, 2 skipped, 0 failed -- byte-identical to 149O.9's, 149O.10's, and 149O.10.1's own Fast Green baseline, confirming no collateral regression. Targeted regression sweep (pytest -k 'hatp or rollback or permission_broker or 149o_9 or 149o_10', excluding the pre-existing fido2-import collection failure): 3022 passed, 3 skipped, 10 failed on this phase's working tree; independently re-run against a git-stash-clean checkout of the unmodified base commit (4516d000): 2956 passed, 3 skipped, 10 failed, identical 10 test names in both runs -- the 66-test delta is exactly this phase's own new suite; all 10 failures independently reconfirmed pre-existing, not introduced by this phase, and identical to the 10-item set 149O.10 itself already found and disclosed. Report-trust suite (test_phase_report_trust_hard_fail.py, test_phase_report_trust_gate_cli.py, test_phase_report_trust_gate.py, test_task_finish_report_trust_notification.py): 119 passed, run as a sanity check since this phase touches no report/finalization production code. VERDICT: 149O.10-F-3 INDEPENDENTLY CONFIRMED CLOSED. SC-7 NO-CLOBBER: INDEPENDENTLY VERIFIED. ATOMIC EXCLUSIVE PUBLICATION: INDEPENDENTLY VERIFIED RACE-SAFE AT CONTRACT LEVEL. F-1/F-2/Obs-2: INDEPENDENTLY CONFIRMED CLOSED. Contract verdict: VERIFIED WITH NON-BLOCKING FINDINGS -- HSCE-001 v1.1 CONFORMS. HSCE-001 v1.1: READY FOR IMPLEMENTATION PLANNING (not an implementation itself). No production code modified. HSCE-001 v1.1, HATP-001 v1.0, and RAE-001 v1.0 all remain byte-unchanged by this phase. B-149O-1..4 remain INDEPENDENTLY VERIFIED AT HATP-GATED AUTHORITY BOUNDARY -- SYSTEM EXECUTION CLOSURE DEFERRED. HATP production remains NOT READY. Runtime remains Observed / observe / unavailable. Full detail in docs/PHASE_149O_10_2_HSCE_001_ATOMIC_NO_CLOBBER_REPAIR_INDEPENDENT_REVERIFICATION.md. Recommended next phase: 149O.11, HATP Signing Ceremony + Evidence Store Implementation Plan.
